summary: P3 Health Partners filed an 8-K about a Debt Exchange Agreement with CPF affiliates to exchange ~$252.5M of promissory notes for non-convertible, non-voting preferred stock series (A: 13.5%, B: 17.5%, C: 19.5% cumulative) at $100 stated value per share, aiming to regain Nasdaq compliance. Additionally, a Securities Purchase Agreement was signed for up to $70M in units from CPF. This debt-for-equity swap reduces leverage but dilutes equity structurally; the preferred is redeemable at par. The move is a capital restructuring to meet listing requirements. Watch for Nasdaq approval and CPF's continued influence.
